        # Only perform the Column C move if both source and target cells are inside A13:C14
        if (
            min_row <= row <= max_row
            and min_row <= row + 1 <= max_row
            and min_col <= 3 <= max_col
            and is_empty(target_c.value)
        ):
            target_c.value = source_c.value
            source_c.value = None
